summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Plug Power Inc. reporting the results of its annual meeting of stockholders held on June 11, 2026. Stockholders voted on the election of four Class III directors, approval of an amendment to the 2021 Stock Option and Incentive Plan to increase share reserve by 25 million shares, a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation, and ratification of Deloitte as auditor. All proposals were approved. The filing also notes the resignation of a director effective June 11, reducing board size from ten to nine. This is a standard current report on shareholder votes and board composition changes, not a special situation.
